OpenAI CEO Sam Altman rules out 2026 IPO, cites AI safety concerns

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has stated that the company will not pursue a public debut in 2026. He cited mounting artificial intelligence safety fears as a reason for delaying an initial public offering (IPO). Altman made these remarks in an exclusive interview with Fortune. Other outlets reporting on the interview also noted Altman's stance on the IPO timeline and the AI safety concerns.
